text: Welcome.
Go ahead and find a comfortable position.
Sitting or lying down, whatever feels right.
And when you're ready, let your eyes close.
Feel the surface beneath you.
The weight of your body resting.
Held.
Take a full breath in through the nose.
And let it go slowly through the mouth.
There's nowhere you need to be right now.
Everything you need for this moment is already here.
Now bring your attention to the center of your chest.
The space around your heart.
And imagine a warmth beginning there.
Soft.
Steady.
Like sunlight settling into your skin on a quiet afternoon.
Let that warmth expand with each breath.
Spreading across your chest.
Into your shoulders.
Down through your arms.
All the way to your hands.
Down through your legs.
Into the soles of your feet.
This warmth is yours.
It's always been here.
You're just turning your attention toward it.
Now I'd like you to think about something you already have.
Something real and present in your life right now.
A relationship.
A place you feel safe.
Something you've built with your own hands.
Whatever comes to mind first, let it arrive.
And as you hold that in your awareness,
Notice what happens in your body.
Maybe a softening in your chest.
A steadiness in your breathing.
A feeling of fullness that has nothing to do with acquiring anything new.
This isn't about pretending everything is easy.
This is what abundance feels like in the body.
Your nervous system already knows the difference between wanting and having.
Between reaching and receiving.
Between striving and resting in what's already enough.
Let yourself rest there now.
In the feeling of enough.
Breathing in, letting the warmth grow brighter.
Breathing out, letting it settle deeper.
Now imagine that warmth in your chest beginning to glow.
A soft golden light.
With each breath, it expands a little further.
Into the space around you.
Abundance isn't something you chase.
It's something you allow.
Something you return to when the noise gets quiet enough to feel it.
And the more you practice this feeling,
the more available it becomes.
In ordinary moments.
During your morning coffee.
Walking through a doorway.
Sitting in your car before you start the engine.
Abundance lives in the pause.
In the moment you choose to notice what's already here.
Breathing in, I have enough.
Breathing out, I am enough.
Gently now, begin to bring your awareness back.
Feel the surface beneath you again.
Wiggle your fingers.
Your toes.
Take a deep breath in.
And let it out with a sigh.
And when you're ready, at your own pace, let your eyes open.
Carry this with you.
It's yours.
